mapper.select: SELECT a.product_id AS product_id, b.product_id AS other_product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS cnt FROM order_item a JOIN order_item b ON b.order_id = a.order_id AND b.product_id <> a.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = a.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('PAID', 'PREPARING', 'SHIPPED', 'DELIVERED') AND o.created_at >= #{sinceAt} GROUP BY a.product_id, b.product_id

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.artist_id, p.label_id, YEAR(p.release_date) AS release_year, p.avg_rating AS average_rating, p.created_at, p.status, GROUP_CONCAT(pg.genre_id) AS genre_ids FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_genre pg ON pg.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id
